traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Imaginative ideas that turn out to have practical application. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize growth and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what growth and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
